## About
Arvada Autobody is a full service automotive center on Kendall Ct in Arvada, serving our own community and the entire Denver Metro Area. We handle auto body, collision repair, hail damage, and everyday repair and maintenance on domestic and import vehicles.
Susan is the voice behind our shop, and reviewers know her too. One customer said Susan was very kind and willing to answer their weekly calls while their car was being repaired. Another wrote that Steve touched up the paint and some rust on his truck and polished it to an awesome shine.
We hold a 4.5 rating from 24 Google reviews. One reviewer who says she's not a car person told us we make an intimidating situation much less stressful, and that she never feels over charged or taken advantage of.

## Services
- Collision Repair: Fender benders to bigger wrecks, repaired and back on the road.
- Hail Damage Conventional & PDR Repairs: Hail damage fixed with conventional repairs or paintless dent repair.
- Frame Repairs: Frame work after a collision, along with chassis repair.
- Custom Paint: Custom paint work, classic car restorations and show cars.
- Oil Change: Oil changes, fluid changes and filter changes.
- Tune Ups: Regular tune ups to keep your car running right. (from $169.99)
- Check Engine Diagnosis & Repair: We use the latest technology to assess the situation and offer you alternatives.
- Lift Kits & Custom Wheels & Tires: Lift kits, custom wheels and tires, plus tire rotation and mount and balance.

## FAQ
Q: Do you work with my insurance company?
A: Yes. We work with all insurance companies.

Q: What vehicles do you work on?
A: We service and repair all makes and models of domestic and import vehicles, from Acura and BMW to Subaru and Toyota.

Q: Are the parts warrantied?
A: Yes. Parts are warrantied by the manufacturer.

Q: Can you build a custom vehicle?
A: Come in and talk with one of our Service Advisors. We'll work up a price quote for you, and then we can build your dream vehicle together.

## What customers say
- "I never write reviews. However, I wanted to show my gratitude towards this business. Unfortunately, I wrecked my car on December 30th 2022. The whole front right side was messed up. I tried to get a in network auto shop with my insurance but they were all backed up and wouldn't be able to start working on my car for at least a couple months. Luckily I found Arvada Autobody/360 Degrees of perfection (they work together) they were able to take my car in the same day of the crash and get the initial estimate within a few days. That was including the weekend and New Year holiday.

They also made a supplement due to the damages being more severe than they thought after breaking the car down. Susan was very kind and willing to answer my calls (weekly basis I called). Due to being out of network my insurance took some time to pay them out but while I was waiting to get the money from the insurance on the supplement, I was under the impression the auto shop was waiting for that money as well, to order the needed parts then conduct the labor. Indeed, I was wrong and shocked to get a update saying my vehicle would be ready February 2nd 2023. It only took them 34 days! They should have been paid out in full now but they gave my car back to me even before they received the full amount from my insurance. All I did was pay my $500.00 deductible and I got my car back. I was very surprised and my car looks good as new and runs perfect. I will definitely come here in the future if I need anything worked on." (Dale Collier, 5/5)
